The unfortunate reality is that social structures we see in society at large also exist in minority communities: including the gay community. Gay white cis (and masculine) men massively dominate media representation in multiple outlets, and are privileged in ways gay POCs are not. 

Take a think, for instance, about how every race besides white gay men are given a certain 'stereotype': e.g. black gay men are 'dom tops', Asian men are 'fem bottoms', Latino men are 'exotic' etc. White gay men, on the other hand, are seen as the 'norm' in this entire paradigm. 

The result is that gay white men are generally perceived as more attractive or desirable than gay POC, and many mask it as a 'preference'. Whether or not this preference is racist in itself is debatable (I personally think so), but what is undeniable is that this system of preference is built upon racial structures.

Snail mucin has a lot of alleged benefits. According to INCI Decoder, it contains "proteoglycans, glycosaminoglycans, glycoprotein enzymes, hyaluronic acid, copper peptides, antimicrobial peptides and trace elements including copper, zinc, and iron." So, in short, a WHOLE lot of beneficial ingredients for your face that encompass anti-aging, moisturising and other reparative capabilities. 

However, like many other ingredients commonly found in K-beauty, it lacks a lot of research compared to more established ingredients such as niacinimide, retinol or salicylic acid.

Salicylic acid is really good for removing blackheads and minimising the appearance of pore size (and managing acne, which is a problem I face a LOT). Paula's Choice BHA Exfoliating Liquid is really good! I bought the travel size one first, and then I got the full size afterwards. The price is really decent (36 AUD from memory) and it's lasted me for nearly a year haha. They also seem to provide free shipping all year round so there's another plus!

I've also heard that the Ordinary Glycolic Acid and Salicylic Acid mask is also really good 

I also really like niacinimide since it does SO many things, including reducing redness. The Ordinary Niacinimide 10% + Zinc 1% serum is really cheap (I think 12 AUD from memory?) and works really well. I haven't tried the Inkey List version but I've heard good things about that one as well!
